<subject>Electronic Transactions Agreement - revised</subject>
<body>
As you know, the ETA has to address Nextel Wireless one-to-many with Maple & Crown and Rogers Communications one-to-many with Maple & Crown. We also need a separate Nextel Wireless GTC one-to-many with Maple & Crown and Separate Rogers Communications GTC one-to-many with Maple & Crown. We also need a single Telus Mobility application that addresses Bell Canada, both one-to-many.

As soon as these drafts are complete, I would like to read them!

Thanks.

GP
</body>
<quoted>
---------------------- Forwarded by Lee Mills on 7/10/2024 11:33 AM ---------------------------
From: Travis McCullough@maplecrown.ca on 7/9/2024 08:33 PM
To: Lee Mills, Nicholas Porter, John Cummings, Bradley Miller, Douglas Dixon, Harry M Collins, Sandra Wood
cc:
Subject: Electronic Transactions Agreement - revised

Attached is a revised version of the ETA omitting the distinction between transactions on Rogers Communications and transactions on Nextel Wireless. If Maple & Crown is the only party permitted to post services on Rogers Communications, there is no need for the special rules that we drafted for what was previously a "many-to-many" peering arrangement. However, we will need to develop a different set of GTCs for transactions that Maple & Crown closes on Rogers Communications, since the services transacted on Rogers Communications are not likely to be the type that lend themselves to Maple & Crown's standard GTCs.
